milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near and face the light_blue_glazed_terracotta pillars at the building entrance. Target is the right pillar at spawn-relative (10, 1, 3), which is ~10 blocks from spawn and requires intentional navigation to the entrance side. Max distance 5 with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player has actually approached and is looking at the terracotta rather than trivially satisfying from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as an item into the player's inventory. The light_blue_bed is inside the bedroom at spawn-relative (8-9, 0, 8). Since the player starts with no light_blue_bed in inventory, having one confirms the bed was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks where the drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has with glass_bottle because drinking a potion in Minecraft consumes the potion and leaves an empty glass_bottle in the player's inventory. Since the player starts with no glass_bottle, detecting one confirms a potion was drunk. The healing potion is an item entity near the nightstand at spawn-relative (10, 2, 8) — player must pick it up, equip it, and use it to drink.
